Grading queue

/teach/courses/:courseId/grading
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S17

Show review work by assessment, learner/group, question and allocation so staff know exactly what remains.

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Open older attempt
  • Current versus selected receipt time and grading-attempt rule
  • Selecting old work does not replace latest receipt or release
Return without applying changesOpen selected receipt
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Queue and TA calendar show the same task ID and grading due time.
  • Saving one of four allocated questions does not mark review complete.
  • A permission refresh removes out-of-scope work without leaking learner names/counts.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
